compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Gerrit 3118 (task 1ebf-599a-e15c-465d) added `_linux_host_script_skip_reason` and a call to it in `pytest_collection_modifyitems` in tests/conftest.py. The pure helper is pinned by tests/unit/test_conftest_windows_skip_rule.py; the glue that reads `sys.platform`, computes the repo-relative path and adds the skip marker has no committed test. The review bot raised this as an advisory. It was checked once with a throwaway probe (492 skipped on win32, 0 on Linux), which is not in the repo.

## Approach
Extend tests/unit/test_conftest_windows_skip_rule.py (loaded the way tests/unit/test_collection_isolation_guard.py loads the root conftest): call `pytest_collection_modifyitems` with a fake item under tests/scripts/test_vartmp_cap.py and `sys.platform` patched to win32, and assert a skip marker whose reason names 1ebf-599a-e15c-465d; repeat with linux and assert no skip marker.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Two new test cases drive `pytest_collection_modifyitems`: win32 adds the skip marker and linux does not. Checked by running them, and by showing one fails when the glue call is removed.
compiled_state.title: Test the Windows skip glue in the collection hook
